# Chiplet_Wafer_Topology

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A design paradigm where topology-aware interconnects are applied across chiplets and wafers, treating them as a unified network fabric. Critical for TCC because it allows network-centric computing to scale beyond single dies, leveraging wafer-level integration for massive parallelism.
